## Checklist

- [ ] I edited YAML sources, not generated tables or JSON.
- [ ] Unknown values are left `unknown`; nothing is inferred (no RAM from weight size).
- [ ] Any `reported`/`theoretical` compatibility has an evidence URL; `reproduced` points to a `benchmarks/` record.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run audit -- --strict` passes.
- [ ] `npm run links` passes (or new links were verified manually).
